title: Ball Thrown Vertically Upward
body: A ball is thrown vertically upward from the ground with an initial velocity of 25 m/s. Taking upward as positive and using $$g = 10 \ m/s^2$$, calculate: (a) the maximum height reached by the ball, and (b) the total time the ball is in the air before returning to the ground.
oer: Siyavula Physical Sciences Grade 12 - Vertical Projectile Motion
